slices.title: Server-side streaming and durable events
slices.intent: Compaction summarizer streams via streamLLM and the runtime emits durable compaction_start/delta/end lifecycle events with token metadata and authoritative end text; deltas prune to first and last.

symbols.name: HOST_AGENT_LIFECYCLE
symbols.expectation: Lifecycle constant gains compactionStart/Delta/End names; browser subscription derives them automatically.

symbols.name: CompactionCardEvent
symbols.expectation: Discriminated union start/delta/end; end carries entryId, tokensBefore, tokensAfter, summary.

symbols.name: CompactionRuntimeOptions
symbols.expectation: Options gain emitEvent sink; summarizer type gains onDelta before signal.

symbols.name: generateCompactionSummary

before.signature: (messages: AgentMessage[], focus: string, maxOutputTokens: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<string>

postcondition.signature: (messages: AgentMessage[], focus: string, maxOutputTokens: number, onDelta: (text: string) => void, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<string>

symbols.expectation: Streams via streamLLM stage maic-agent-compaction; onDelta receives accumulated text per text delta.

symbols.name: makeCompactionRuntime
symbols.expectation: Emits start before summarizer, deltas during, end after rebuild; no end on failure; disabled emits nothing.

symbols.name: runSession
symbols.expectation: Runner maps emitEvent to durable emit with 150ms delta throttle and prunes deltas on end append.

symbols.name: AgentSessionEventLog
symbols.expectation: Event log interface gains pruneCompactionDeltas member.

symbols.name: pruneCompactionDeltas
symbols.expectation: Deletes middle compaction_delta rows between start boundary and end seq, keeping first and last.

slices.title: Workbench fold and replay
slices.intent: Workbench fold learns the three compaction events: inline streaming card node, settle on end with tokens and summary, replay keeps first and last delta, live and replayed rows byte-identical.

symbols.name: ChatNodeKind
symbols.expectation: Union gains compaction kind.

symbols.name: ChatNode
symbols.expectation: Node gains optional tokensBefore, tokensAfter, entryId fields.

symbols.name: WorkbenchFold
symbols.expectation: Fold gains compactionKey pointer to the open compaction node.

symbols.name: createInitialSessionState
symbols.expectation: Factory returns compactionKey null.

symbols.name: foldEvent
symbols.expectation: Three cases: start converts or creates streaming node; delta overwrites text; end settles with summary and tokens; fallbacks settle.

symbols.name: compactReplayEvents
symbols.expectation: REPLAY_STREAMING includes compaction_delta so replay keeps first and last frame.

symbols.name: appendCompactedReplayEvent
symbols.expectation: Compacts compaction_delta runs like message_update runs.

slices.title: Compaction card UI and i18n parity
slices.intent: CompactionBlock renders the thinking-card shape with a Shrink icon: running label, settled token label, streamed preview, expandable full summary; three copy keys across all twelve workbench locales.

symbols.name: CompactionBlock

postcondition.signature: (props: { text: string; streaming?: boolean; tokensBefore?: string; tokensAfter?: string; endedAt?: number; stackPosition?: ToolStackPosition; t?: WorkbenchTranslator }): JSX.Element

symbols.expectation: Thinking-card shape with Shrink icon, label, preview, chevron, expanded pre body; collapsed by default.

symbols.name: compactionBarSummary

postcondition.signature: (input: { streaming: boolean; before?: string; after?: string }, t?: WorkbenchTranslator): string

symbols.expectation: Running label while streaming; token label when both counts exist; plain done otherwise.

symbols.name: compactionBarPreview
symbols.expectation: Last nonempty line capped at 200 chars, same algorithm as thinking preview.

symbols.name: useCompactionBar
symbols.expectation: Collapse contract identical to thinking bar.

symbols.name: formatTokens
symbols.expectation: 112000 renders 112K; 1200000 renders 1.2M; below 1000 raw.

symbols.name: ActionCluster
symbols.expectation: Renders CompactionBlock for compaction nodes in the bar stack.

symbols.name: rowsForRender
symbols.expectation: isActionBar and view handle compaction; compaction nodes form their own run key.

symbols.name: workbenchEn
symbols.expectation: Gains compaction.active, doneWithTokens, done English copy.

symbols.name: workbenchZh
symbols.expectation: Gains the same three keys in Chinese.
